# Repository instructions

- Numa is a cross-platform design system targeting React Web and React Native; the current repository primarily contains token JSON and typography tooling.
- Treat repository JSON as the source of truth and keep canonical tokens platform-independent.
- Inspect the relevant implementation and generated outputs before proposing or making changes.
- Consult [Foundation documentation](../docs/foundation/README.md) when working on tokens, typography, architecture, or generation.
- Do not invent token values, categories, or naming conventions.
- Do not add dependencies without a clear need.
- Preserve established architectural decisions and distinguish implemented behavior from planned functionality.
- Keep generated files identifiable and do not treat generated outputs as source inputs without verifying the workflow.
